inspiration: Bill Ackman / Pershing Square — thesis-driven, high conviction, catalyst-oriented
scopeNote: All decisions based solely on the $100 Agentic account. Other LP accounts are irrelevant to fund thesis.
clientMandate: Generate absolute returns with thesis discipline on equity only. **LP target: +25% annual** on Agentic NAV (soft — never force risk to hit it). Options disabled by LP (2026-08-02). Concentrated Ackman bets + SPCX satellite compounder. Not index-hugging.

returnPlan.annualTargetNote: Ackman core busca >25% alpha vía tesis (trim/exit/rotate). SPCX satellite: compounder 10y, nunca vender. Al vender core, reciclar % de proceeds a SPCX solo si tiene sentido.

spcxRecyclePolicy.appliesTo: ackman-core SELL and partial trims only — never SPCX
spcxRecyclePolicy.note: LP 2026-08-05: cada venta/trim del book Ackman → apartar 25% del proceeds para pool SPCX. Deploy solo si gates pasan — no comprar por comprar.
deployGates: SPCX LP thesis intact (10y / never sell)
precio razonable: debilidad relativa (ej. ≤5d high −5%, o en tercio inferior 52w range, o post-corrección post-earnings) — NO perseguir rip
skip si SPCX ya > maxSatelliteAumPct sin LP override
agente documenta PASS con razón si gates no pasan — cash queda en book hasta próxima ventana

lpSatelliteUniverse.name: SpaceX
lpSatelliteUniverse.maxAumPctNote: Cap blando satélite; crece vía spcxRecyclePolicy (25% proceeds en exits core)
lpSatelliteUniverse.exitPolicy: no-discretionary-exit — accumulate on weakness; never trim/rotate salvo mandato LP explícito
lpSatelliteUniverse.returnPlanRole: long-term-compounder — supports LP +25% annual blended return; scorecard checkpoint +25% from entry (no sell)
rules: NO compite en ranking diario #1 vs nombres Ackman — evaluar solo vía thesis memo LP
NO usar composite score de signal-weights como gate de entrada
Horizonte LP: 10 años o nunca vender — NO aplicar decision tree event-trade ni kill criteria Ackman de corto plazo
Unlock / earnings / capex headlines = ruido de entrada (DCA/acumular), no triggers de PASS
get_financials puede estar vacío o incompleto — no penalizar como mega-cap
Convicción por acumulación LP, no por catalizador 3–12m
Ignorar peso Ackman en scoring — 0% confluence by design
Starter $15 = toe-hold; escalar vía spcxRecyclePolicy (25% proceeds al vender/trim core)
Contribuye al plan LP +25% anual — checkpoint scorecard +25% desde entry; NO vender al checkpoint
NO comprar por comprar — evaluar deployGates en spcxRecyclePolicy antes de cada add

ackmanPrinciples: Write the thesis before capital goes in
Exit when thesis breaks — not calendar
Explain decisions like an investor letter
Judge only the $100 fund book — ignore external accounts
ackmanTrackerNote: Confluencia/hunting ground, NO copia mecánica del 13F. HHH = único vehículo directo Ackman permitido con tesis propia.
